ui-indicators.reason: Noninteractive UI status/count badges share surrounding UI proportions. Explicit size wins; PresenceDot maps xs to sm; two-rung UnreadBadge/EnergyBadge map xs/sm to sm and md/lg to md. Semantic status/rating colors remain independent of scope tone.
ui-indicators.verification: mock-rendered native and DOM web: default, nearest, explicit, nested, wrappers, actual portal; physical layout and device accessibility pending; Chromium actual geometry and accessible-name attributes: 16 hosts across xs/sm/md/lg plus explicit md, light/dark at 390/1100 CSS px (4 scenarios)

bloom-scope-applicable.reason: BloomScope is the public owner of inherited Bloom size, tone, control-density, content-density and panel-radius context. Nearest scopes override parent values while omitted fields inherit independently; children remain mounted under ordinary wrappers and portals.
bloom-scope-applicable.verification: Native renderer and DOM web exercise default, nearest scope, partial xs/lg mappings, explicit-size precedence, nested scopes in both override orders, and ordinary wrappers for real controls. Both suites repeat the inheritance matrix through Portal; independent document/artwork subjects remain unchanged under xs/lg scopes.

aspect-ratio-independent-scale.reason: AspectRatio owns a numeric width-to-height geometry with a square fallback; it has no Bloom size prop. Its single host keeps that ratio while caller controls inside it continue to resolve the nearest BloomScope.
aspect-ratio-independent-scale.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the 2:1 aspect geometry and 100% width while a nested Button resolves default md, inherited xs/sm/md/lg and nested lg-over-xs. Existing native tests cover ratio fallback, style precedence and single-host structure; physical layout remains device-owned.

segmented-control-size.reason: SegmentedControl owns a coherent interactive size scale for segment height, track geometry, text and focus target. It consumes all four BloomScope rungs directly; an explicit size overrides the nearest scope.
segmented-control-size.verification: Native-renderer and DOM web verify default md, xs/sm/md/lg geometry, nested lg over xs, explicit lg over xs, ordinary wrappers and an actual portal; physical touch-target fit and device accessibility remain pending

concentric-geometry.reason: ConcentricView owns rounded-corner geometry derived from radius, padding, border and margin; it has no Bloom control-size prop. It renders children inside its geometry context without replacing BloomScope, so child controls keep the nearest scope and explicit size precedence.
concentric-geometry.verification: native renderer and DOM web verify default md, nearest xs/lg, nested lg over xs, explicit md over xs through nested ConcentricView wrappers; fixed radius 32 remains geometry-owned. ConcentricView owns no portal or submenu. Physical-device geometry remains unverified

connection-status-toasts.reason: ConnectionStatusToasts renders null and sends only messages, intent and duration to Bloom's shared Toast engine. ToastHost owns the visible notification and its size contract; this reporter has no UI whose size scope it could consume.
connection-status-toasts.verification: native renderer and DOM web prove the reporter emits no view under xs scope and delegates an offline message without a size value; ToastHost owns the rendered surface. Platform-specific network signals remain tested at their respective boundaries

code-document.reason: CodeLines size selects code typography/line-number metrics (sm 11/18, md 13/23), not chrome or touch targets. CodeBlock passes its content size deliberately; surrounding control scope must not silently rewrite source-code reading density.
code-document.verification: native mock and DOM web verify independent defaults under xs/lg control scopes and explicit document/artwork sizes; physical-device rendering pending

markdown-document.reason: Markdown size sets a whole document reading recipe (body, heading hierarchy and block spacing). Its MarkdownProvider passes that explicit document size to blocks. A compact toolbar is not permission to shrink document text.
markdown-document.verification: native mock and DOM web verify independent defaults under xs/lg control scopes and explicit document/artwork sizes; physical-device rendering pending

audio-art.reason: AudioWaveVisualizer size sets waveform amplitude box/bar thickness (heights 24/40/72). It is hidden decorative signal artwork with data-driven levels, not a control or a status-label typography recipe. Keep explicit artwork dimensions rather than making control scope alter signal amplitude geometry.
audio-art.verification: native mock and DOM web verify independent defaults under xs/lg control scopes and explicit document/artwork sizes; physical-device rendering pending

scrollbar-visual.reason: ScrollBar's size prop is scrollbar thumb thickness on web (sm 4px, md 6px), not Bloom control size; the hit strip adds 6px without taking content space. Native renders no overlay and leaves the operating system indicator to its ScrollView. Native and web runtime tests verify the control scope cannot change this role-specific geometry and the explicit web size remains effective.
scrollbar-visual.verification: native renderer returns no overlay for xs/lg scopes and sm/md thickness props; web measures track/thumb at 10/4px for sm and 12/6px for md under both xs and lg scopes; actual native platform indicator appearance remains OS-owned

button-delegation.reason: Each named Button composition renders the shared Button with the complete props spread and no size default. Both native/web implementations delegate size precedence directly; appearance/tone/iconOnly defaults do not consume or replace size.
button-delegation.verification: all nine public Button compositions render on native and DOM web; xs from nearest BloomScope and explicit lg override are measured for boxed wrappers and LinkButton typography; default/nested/portal matrix remains pending

glyph-art.reason: Published SVG glyph components paint an explicitly supplied numeric width/height/fill or icon-token size. The consuming control owns control geometry; a glyph is not a second control-size owner.
glyph-art.verification: source classification of glyph contracts; glyph-specific visual regression not implied

accordion-root-part.reason: Accordion accepts an explicit size override and applies it through BloomScope to its entire compound tree; when omitted, the nearest caller scope remains in force. The renderer keeps state/interaction ownership separate from visual context.
accordion-root-part.verification: native mock and RNW DOM verify default md, inherited xs, nested xs then lg, and explicit root sm over inherited lg; descendants receive the resolved scope; physical-device layout pending

accordion-item-part.reason: AccordionItem owns disclosure state membership and a semantic divider, not a size recipe. Its child trigger/content remain under the nearest BloomScope and resolve their own geometry.
accordion-item-part.verification: native mock and RNW DOM exercise the actual AccordionItem > AccordionTrigger/AccordionContent composition under default md, inherited xs, nested xs/lg, and explicit root sm; physical-device layout pending

accordion-trigger-part.reason: AccordionTrigger is an interactive disclosure control. Its typography, vertical padding, icon and gap now follow the inherited or explicit Accordion size recipe while preserving the established md geometry.
accordion-trigger-part.verification: native mock and RNW DOM measure md 15/12/8px, xs 12/8/6px, sm 13/10/8px and lg 17/14/10px typography/padding/gap under inherited, nested and explicit sizes; native touch renderer keeps 44px minimum height; physical-device target fit pending

accordion-content-part.reason: AccordionContent owns measured disclosure-body spacing. Its trailing padding follows the same inherited size scale so the animated content measurement stays aligned with the trigger recipe.
accordion-content-part.verification: native mock measures body padding at xs 8px, sm 10px, md 12px and lg 14px; RNW DOM verifies the matching size-specific body CSS recipe under inherited, nested and explicit sizes; physical-device layout pending

text-field-core.reason: TextField owns the shared field shell and propagates its resolved size to TextFieldInput; standalone TextFieldInput owns its own standard control geometry. Both participate in BloomScope sizing, with explicit size taking precedence. Adornments and hosted parts remain separately classified.
text-field-core.verification: native renderer and RNW DOM verify default md (36px), inherited xs (28px), inherited lg (44px), explicit field lg and standalone input md overrides inside xs, nested xs/lg, and actual native/web portals; physical-device layout and accessibility remain pending

connection-dots-art.reason: ConnectionDots is a relationship illustration, not a control. dotSize and dotCount are explicit artwork dimensions, so the row and dots do not consume BloomScope control size. The left/right endpoints are rendered as supplied and preserve caller and nested child-control scopes.
connection-dots-art.verification: Native-renderer and DOM web checks verify default md endpoints, inherited xs, nested lg, explicit child size, and independent dot diameter/count. This family does not own portals or submenus; physical-device geometry remains unverified.

radio-control-size.reason: Radio, RadioGroup and its default/chip/swatch variants, RadioChip, and RadioSwatch resolve the nearest BloomScope size. An explicit size overrides that scope; the variants retain distinct indicator, pill, and disc geometry.
radio-control-size.verification: Native-renderer and DOM web suites verify unscoped md, nearest xs, nested lg over xs, explicit lg over xs, ordinary wrappers and a real portal for Radio, RadioGroup default/chip/swatch variants, RadioChip and RadioSwatch. These are renderer checks; physical geometry and device accessibility remain pending. These parts own no submenu

checkbox-switch-controls.reason: Checkbox and Switch own interactive controls whose box, label recipe, track and thumb geometry resolve BloomScope size. Explicit size overrides the nearest scope; this is the standard control size contract, not content or artwork density.
checkbox-switch-controls.verification: Native-renderer and DOM web suites verify default md, nearest xs, nested lg over xs, explicit lg over xs, ordinary wrappers and an actual portal for both controls; physical geometry, assistive-technology behavior and device accessibility remain pending. These parts own no submenu

select-control-size.reason: Select resolves trigger geometry, value typography and chevron size from its explicit size or nearest BloomScope. SelectContent establishes an independent menu density for option rows, group spacing, indicators and separators; SelectField delegates its trigger size to Select. The option list and trigger are separate size owners by design.
select-control-size.verification: Native renderer verifies trigger padding, 44dp touch target, value and chevron at default md, xs/sm/md/lg scopes, nested scope, actual React portal, explicit override, SelectField delegation and an open sm content list under an xs scope and lg trigger. Web DOM verifies trigger geometry/type/glyph across md defaults and all scale rungs, wrappers, nested scopes, portal and explicit override; a real FloatingPanel portal verifies independent sm option density, row text, selected indicator, group spacing and separator margin under xs scope/lg trigger. Physical Android rendering and accessibility remain pending.

breadcrumb-control-size.reason: Breadcrumb and BreadcrumbItem resolve label typography, icon geometry and interactive hit-area recipe from the nearest BloomScope size. Explicit size wins, and native touch targets remain at least 44 points across visual size rungs.
breadcrumb-control-size.verification: Native renderer verifies inherited nested lg scope, explicit md item override, label typography and 44-point item target; existing web DOM tests verify inherited xs/sm/md/lg through the trail and explicit trail override. Physical device geometry and accessibility remain pending.

close-button-independent-size.reason: CloseButton owns a compact dismiss-action geometry with an xs default and explicit 2xs/xs/sm/md/lg overrides; the intentionally compact default does not inherit BloomScope size. Its dimensions describe the dismiss affordance, not surrounding content density.
close-button-independent-size.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify that lg scope leaves the xs default at 20 points/pixels and explicit lg overrides an xs scope to 44; existing native geometry coverage checks the component size table. Physical-device proportions and accessibility remain pending.

call-stage-control-size.reason: CallControls and CallControlButton resolve call-stage button geometry from the nearest BloomScope. The specialized full-stage default is lg; the supported xs scope maps to sm because call controls have sm/md/lg geometry. An explicit size wins, while fixed caption typography and tones remain role-owned.
call-stage-control-size.verification: Native renderer and web DOM verify default lg, xs-to-sm mapping, sm/md/lg scopes, explicit md override, nested lg over xs through a wrapper, group spacing, and standalone CallControlButton geometry. Call controls own no portal or submenu; physical-device proportions and accessibility remain pending.

input-group-control-size.reason: InputGroup owns the single input shell and resolves its field geometry from the explicit size or nearest BloomScope, defaulting to md. It also publishes the resolved size through TextFieldGroupContext so its field and addons remain one coordinated control.
input-group-control-size.verification: Native renderer and web DOM verify default md, xs/sm/md/lg scope geometry, nested scopes, explicit sm override, and noPadding addon insets derived from each rung. The group owns no portal or submenu; physical-device proportions and input hit testing remain pending.

input-group-addon-size-delegation.reason: InputGroupAddon has no public size prop; inside a group it consumes the group's resolved size to calculate noPadding inset and follows the group's shared shell context. Outside a group its fallback geometry remains md.
input-group-addon-size-delegation.verification: Native renderer and web DOM verify that the addon inset follows xs/sm/md/lg group geometry and an explicit nested sm group size; addon label typography remains the fixed body-regular role. Physical-device layout remains pending.

time-field-partial-size.reason: TimeField resolves its text-field geometry from the explicit size or nearest BloomScope, defaulting to md. Its two-step recipe maps xs/sm to the small 96×32 field and md/lg to the medium 104×38 field; the intermediate rungs are intentionally not distinct geometries.
time-field-partial-size.verification: Native renderer and web DOM verify default md, xs/sm-to-small and md/lg-to-medium mappings, nested scopes, explicit sm override, and actual width/height. TimeField owns no portal or submenu; keyboard/IME and device input behavior remain covered by their separate field checks, while physical proportions remain pending.

field-label-partial-size.reason: Label owns field-name typography and resolves its type-ramp step from explicit size or the nearest BloomScope, defaulting to sm. Its three-step recipe maps lg to md; label size changes typography and spacing only, never the associated control's target.
field-label-partial-size.verification: Native renderer and web DOM verify default sm, xs/sm/md typography, lg-to-md mapping, nested scopes, and explicit xs override. Label owns no portal or submenu and is not a touch target; physical text scaling and assistive-technology behavior remain pending.

fab-action-size.reason: Fab resolves diameter and icon/label recipe from explicit size or nearest BloomScope, defaulting to md. Its action-specific metrics are xs 40, sm 48, md 50 and lg 64 points/pixels; placement and positioning remain with the caller.
fab-action-size.verification: Native renderer and real web DOM verify default md, xs/sm/md/lg diameters, nested scopes and explicit sm override. Fab owns no portal or submenu; physical hit testing, label fit and device proportions remain pending.

color-swatch-art-size.reason: ColorSwatchPicker's numeric size is the swatch artwork diameter, not a Bloom control rung. The selected ring adds a fixed 10-point frame, while ChoiceList owns the accessible option target; BloomScope does not reinterpret a caller's color-swatch dimensions.
color-swatch-art-size.verification: Native renderer and web DOM verify default 40-point swatch plus 50-point ringed option remains fixed under lg scope, explicit 24-point artwork plus 34-point visual option remains fixed under xs scope, and ChoiceList expands coarse-pointer option hit regions to at least 44px while retaining compact fine-pointer geometry. ChoiceList owns keyboard semantics; physical option hit testing and device proportions remain pending.

select-field-size-delegation.reason: SelectField adds the Field label, description and error layout, then forwards its optional size to the platform-specific Select root. Select remains the owner of trigger size resolution.
select-field-size-delegation.verification: Native renderer and web DOM each pass size xs through SelectField and measure the resulting trigger at its platform geometry and type; physical-device fit remains pending.

select-fixed-menu-parts.reason: SelectLabel is a semantic group heading with a fixed caption type. SelectScrollUpButton and SelectScrollDownButton are optional scroll affordances with fixed 16px glyphs and padding; SelectContent does not mount them, but callers can compose them through SelectScrollProvider on either platform. Their documented roles do not scale with option density.
select-fixed-menu-parts.verification: Native renderer and DOM web compare custom scroll-button glyphs and classes under xs and lg, and verify the fixed caption type beside a differently sized option list; actual device painting remains unverified.

select-scroll-provider.reason: SelectScrollProvider only publishes canScrollUp/canScrollDown and a scroll callback; it renders no visual surface or control geometry for BloomScope to size.
select-scroll-provider.verification: The provider itself emits no UI; native locale coverage confirms it supplies scroll state and localized labels to the optional affordances when mounted.

agent-log-tool-call.reason: AgentLogToolCall owns a fixed body-regular/caption-1 row recipe, 14px status glyph and 6px/4px row spacing rather than a Bloom control-size prop. Optional result children remain caller-owned and keep their nearest scope.
agent-log-tool-call.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify fixed 14px title typography and 6px gap/4px vertical spacing under default md, xs and lg; optional child geometry and physical-device proportions remain unverified.

agent-stack-numeric-size.reason: AgentStack's public size prop is numeric and sets the avatar canvas directly; this artwork geometry has no relationship to BloomScope control-size tokens.
agent-stack-numeric-size.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify a numeric 48px canvas stays fixed under default md, xs and lg scopes; physical avatar proportions remain unverified.

agent-profile-avatar-canvas.reason: AgentProfile composes fixed 56px avatar-canvas geometry and numeric 56px/36px artwork sizes for one agent or an overlapping team. These illustration dimensions describe identity artwork, not a Bloom control-size rung.
agent-profile-avatar-canvas.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the fixed 56px canvas stays unchanged under default md, xs and lg scopes; physical avatar proportions remain unverified.

agent-reply-bubble-text-geometry.reason: AgentReplyBubble calculates vertical inset from explicit text font/line metrics to balance its fixed 12px side inset; it has no Bloom control-size input. Caller content remains nested in the current scope.
agent-reply-bubble-text-geometry.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the default 9px vertical inset stays fixed under default md, xs and lg while a nested Button follows those scopes; custom text metrics and physical material remain unverified.

agent-reply-actions-row.reason: AgentReplyActions sizes its built-in voting and copy buttons explicitly as sm, while caller-provided children pass through unchanged and retain their own nearest BloomScope size contract.
agent-reply-actions-row.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the three built-in buttons remain 32px under default md, xs and lg, while a caller Button child follows all three scopes; touch hit regions and accessibility remain unverified.

agent-reply-action-fixed-size.reason: AgentReplyAction is a bare icon Button that explicitly sets size=sm, so its 32px visual control recipe is independent of the caller's nearest BloomScope.
agent-reply-action-fixed-size.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the 32px button under default md, xs and lg scopes; physical hit-region geometry and accessibility remain unverified.

agent-reply-layout-delegation.reason: AgentReply owns only the reply wrapper's width and spacing. It passes children, identity and actions through as caller-owned nodes without replacing their BloomScope; the embedded controls keep their own size contracts.
agent-reply-layout-delegation.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify caller Button children follow default md, xs and lg while the wrapper keeps its 12px top margin; other slot recipes and physical geometry remain separately unverified.

agent-reply-identity-artwork.reason: AgentReplyIdentity uses its own thinking-state animation to size a fixed 32px AgentAvatar artwork canvas and fixed body typography. These identity and animation dimensions have no Bloom control-size input.
agent-reply-identity-artwork.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the 20px resting wrapper and 32px artwork canvas stay unchanged under default md, xs and lg scopes; thinking animation and device proportions remain separately unverified.

agent-chat-actions-delegation.reason: AgentChatActions composes ButtonGroup and ButtonGroupItem for its share and menu trigger controls. Their shared control recipes consume the nearest BloomScope; the composite adds labels, callbacks and menu content but owns no separate size recipe.
agent-chat-actions-delegation.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify share and menu controls at 34px under default md, 24px under xs and 34px under lg (the group clamps lg to md); open-menu geometry and physical touch behavior remain unverified.

agent-chat-composer-fixed-recipe.reason: AgentChatComposer delegates its pill animation to ComposerLoader and prompt implementation to ComposerPill, whose one-line field is fixed at 20px and whose add/send controls set explicit md and 36px geometry. agent-chat-composer-fixed-recipe.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the 20px prompt field and 36px add/send controls remain fixed under default md, xs and lg; loader material, multiline growth and physical geometry require separate verification.

agent-chat-history-fixed-recipe.reason: AgentChatHistory owns a fixed 260px rail and domain-specific thread rows, including fixed 6px vertical row insets and a 28px age/menu slot. Its labels use named typography variants, and its compact rail geometry has no Bloom control-size prop.
agent-chat-history-fixed-recipe.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify rail width, thread-row insets and trailing slot stay fixed under default md, xs and lg scopes; row touch fit, open menus, account flows and physical layout remain unverified.

agent-chat-message-fixed-recipe.reason: AgentChatMessage authors the user bubble with fixed 12px horizontal and 11px vertical insets, uses named text variants, and sets reply action targets to 28px. agent-chat-message-fixed-recipe.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify authored user-bubble insets and 28px reply actions stay fixed under default md, xs and lg; Markdown descendants, multiline wrapping and physical touch fit remain separately unverified.

agent-chat-composition-delegation.reason: AgentChat owns conversation state and composes AppShell, Screen, PageHeader, PageFooter, AgentChatHistory, AgentChatComposer and AgentChatMessage. agent-chat-composition-delegation.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify an xs scope reaches the share control through AgentChat → AppShell → Screen → PageHeader as 24px, with default md and lg clamped by ButtonGroup to 34px; responsive layouts and other leaf recipes remain separately verified.

agent-thinking-fixed-recipes.reason: AgentThinking is a status indicator with fixed art boxes, a named body-medium label and a 10px row gap; ThinkingReasoning uses fixed spacing tokens, a 2px rule and body-2 text. agent-thinking-fixed-recipes.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify fixed status-row gap, 16px dot grid, 14/20 label typography and reasoning vertical insets under default md, xs and lg; animated frame timing and physical proportions remain unverified.

agent-creator-composition-delegation.reason: AgentCreator composes Screen, PageHeader, ButtonGroup, CloseButton, AgentCreatorField/Section, preference controls and numeric AgentAvatar artwork. It defines no editor-wide size scale; shared controls receive the nearest BloomScope, CloseButton explicitly selects xs, and artwork geometry stays numeric.
agent-creator-composition-delegation.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify undo/redo controls in the actual AgentCreator compose at 34px under default md, 24px under xs and 34px under lg, while its explicit 20px close control remains fixed; child rows, portals and nested/explicit sizes are separately covered, while editor responsiveness and physical fit remain unverified.

usage-card-fixed-recipe.reason: UsageCard is a domain-specific usage visualization with named body typography and authored fixed geometry for cards, bars, legends and limit rows. It exposes no control size prop; BloomScope must not silently change chart or data density.
usage-card-fixed-recipe.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the default card inset, named 14/20 title typography and 6px usage tracks stay fixed under default md, xs and lg BloomScope. Physical-device proportions, dense dashboards and accessibility behavior remain unverified.

agent-limits-card-delegation.reason: Deprecated AgentLimitsCard converts token-domain values and labels to the canonical UsageCard contract, selects its legacy 16px radius, and delegates all visible usage geometry and rendering. It owns no independent control-size scale.
agent-limits-card-delegation.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify token context is rendered through the fixed UsageCard recipe under default md, xs and lg scopes; the adapter's 16px radius, caller format, and labels remain preserved. ambient-photo-independent-geometry.reason: AmbientPhoto is a decorative full-bleed image layer with no control-size prop or content recipe. Its host and photo layers fill the caller-owned region; BloomScope must not alter that geometry.
ambient-photo-independent-geometry.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify full-bleed absolute-fill host/layers remain identical under default md, xs and lg BloomScope. Cropping quality, decoded image memory and platform motion/performance remain separately unverified.

animated-check-artwork-geometry.reason: AnimatedCheck draws fixed ring and check artwork into a square 52-unit viewBox. Its numeric size prop sets only the authored artwork's canvas; the surrounding BloomScope does not define a second control-size contract.
animated-check-artwork-geometry.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify default 24px and explicit 48px SVG canvases remain fixed under xs and lg BloomScope; animation timing and physical optical proportions remain unverified.

ai-chat-message-content-recipes.reason: AiChatBullet, BulletList, LinkChip, MessageLine and Strong encode semantic message content with authored list indentation, marker/artwork geometry, chip padding and named body typography. ai-chat-turn-layout-recipes.reason: AiChatUserMessage owns the right-aligned fixed-inset bubble and its width-relative cap; AiChatAssistantMessage owns a full-width vertical stack with an 8px block gap. ai-chat-shell-headers.reason: AiChatHeader and AiChatMobileHeader compose fixed PageHeader chrome and the shell's navigation/panel islands without exposing their own control-size scale. PageHeader owns the header recipe, while ButtonGroupItem owns and inherits the action control size.
ai-chat-shell-headers.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify fixed 56px header chrome and delegated 34px default/lg versus 24px xs navigation and panel actions. ai-chat-image-generation-artwork.reason: AiChatImageGeneration's artwork owns a fixed 200×250 preview frame and 9px decorative dot field, independent of control size. Its feedback actions keep their own shared turn-action control contract.
ai-chat-image-generation-artwork.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the authored 200×250 image canvas under default md, xs and lg scopes. Generation timing, image loading, responsive fit and physical raster quality remain separate claims.

ai-chat-feedback-row.reason: AiChatFeedbackRow uses an authored fixed 32px visual recipe (8px padding around 16px glyphs) and has no control-size prop. It does not establish that the interactive hit region meets touch accessibility targets.
ai-chat-feedback-row.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify 2px action spacing, 8px button padding and 16px glyphs remain unchanged under default md, xs and lg scopes. Actual touch hit regions, keyboard/touch interaction and assistive-technology behavior remain pending.

ai-chat-code-panel-delegation.reason: AiChatCodePanel owns its explicit width prop and panel composition, but delegates screen scroll/chrome to Screen and PageHeader, action sizing to ButtonGroupItem, tabs to Tabs and code reading typography to CodeLines with an explicit md document size.
ai-chat-code-panel-delegation.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the default 410px panel width and 13/23 code typography remain fixed under default md, xs and lg scopes, while header action geometry follows its owner at 34px for md/lg and 24px for xs. Narrow-panel wrapping, keyboard access and physical fit remain unverified.

ai-chat-container-delegation.reason: AiChatContainer is a conversation composition adapter: Screen owns viewport, scroll and header/footer slots; PageHeader and PageFooter own the rendered chrome; caller content and composer retain their own control-size owners. ai-chat-container-delegation.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the More options action follows the shared header owner at 34px for default md/lg and 24px for xs, while caller thread and composer content remain mounted. Scroll restoration, keyboard/IME behavior, system text scaling and physical interaction remain unverified.

ai-chat-thread-delegation.reason: AiChatThread owns follow-to-end, pagination and scroll-event coordination, but delegates viewport/scroll ownership to Screen and ScreenScrollView. Its caller-supplied child controls retain the nearest BloomScope and explicit size contract.
ai-chat-thread-delegation.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify a caller Button inside AiChatThread follows its own size scale: 36/28/44px at md/xs/lg natively and 36/24/44px on web. Existing thread tests cover follow/pagination contracts; restoration, IME interaction, and physical scroll/touch behavior remain unverified.

ai-chat-gallery-panel-delegation.reason: AiChatGalleryPanel owns its explicit panel width, generation-column distribution and each tile's supplied aspect ratio. Screen/PageHeader own panel chrome, Tabs own view selection, and ButtonGroupItem owns header action sizing; generation data remains caller-owned.
ai-chat-gallery-panel-delegation.verification: Native renderer and DOM web verify the default 410px panel width and 0.5/1/2 generation aspect ratios remain fixed under md/xs/lg scopes, while header actions follow their owner at 34px for md/lg and 24px for xs. Narrow-panel columns, tile touch targets, animation performance and physical image fit remain unverified.

ai-chat-shell-layout-delegation.reason: AiChatShell owns conversation/context panel roles and supplies explicit sidebar and context width constraints to AppShell. AppShell owns panel layout, resize and responsive presentation; PageHeader/ButtonGroupItem own compact chrome and action sizing.
ai-chat-shell-layout-delegation.verification: Native renderer confirms 410/320/560px context width constraints and shell flex geometry are unchanged under md/xs/lg while drawer actions follow ButtonGroupItem at 34/24/34px. Web DOM tests verify compact header action delegation and retained hidden navigation behavior; AppShell owns track rendering. Physical responsive layout, touch fit and device accessibility remain unverified.

ai-profile-card-local-responsive-recipe.reason: AiProfileCard owns its fixed cover/avatar/card recipe and adapts its stats and heatmap from its measured local width.
